Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1795166. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter to standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', pchembl_value IS NOT NULL, and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1795166'. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
